wt%"},"limitations":["Measured static reservoir pressure (BHP test); flowing bottomhole pressure modelled from H-10 surface pressure through the wellbore traverse; declared tubing and fluid assumptions; monthly calendar-day average rate.","The calendar-day rate understates the onstream rate whenever the well had downtime, so J reads low; no correction is made.","The matched month contains the shut-in of at least 24 hours for the test.","H-10 average pressure is a monthly figure, not a flowing pressure measured at the time of the test; it is treated as psig and 14.7 psi is added.","Tubing size, roughness, temperatures and salinity are declared assumptions, not public records; the well is treated as vertical (MD = TVD = test depth).","The basis of the BHP source field is unresolved in the source; the confirmed reading is the user's.","No-friction check: P_wf = surface pressure + (test pressure / test depth) x test depth; it equals the fluid column only if the shut-in svg.text: Points: 3 qualifying tests; the larger point is the chosen J.
Measured static reservoir pressure (BHP test); flowing bottomhole pressure modelled from H-10 surface pressure through the wellbore traverse;
declared tubing and fluid assumptions; monthly calendar-day average rate.
Bars span J under the other basis reading and the tubing sizes 3.958, 4.892 and 6.276 in.
